name: When the Night Comes: Living Dead Girl
source:
Things that go bump in the night are nothing new to the town of Lunaris. It's time to get the gang back together and help a ghoul in need.

[From [url=https://lunarisgames.itch.io/livingdeadgirl]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
对于卢纳里斯镇来说，夜间发生的事情并不新鲜。是时候让这帮人重新团结起来，帮助有需要的食尸鬼了。

[来自[url=https://lunarisgames.itch.io/livingdeadgirl]itch.io[/url]]
